selection: Across the complete nominal passage sampled at 0.20 s, maximize the smaller clearance surplus. Among feasible candidates within 5 mm of the optimum prefer smaller bend and then less altitude change. When all fail, use the largest surplus. Verify the selected route at 0.05 s. Counterfactuals with a predicted shortfall still fly in isolated simulation.
base_setpoint: two smooth progress intervals with nonzero crossing speed, common x at t=29 and common time budget; endpoint base position solved from the common TCP target for each final bend
conditions: known static geometry; fixed y=0,yaw=0,phi=pi; no perception input, external payload, arm-force feed-forward, or physical UAV connection; native PX4 commands the four MuJoCo rotors
positive_control: separate actual native free flight following the frozen Round D receiver trajectory translated by [+0.48,0,+0.65] m; its own gate and task; excluded from comparative counts
primary: all of: whole robot behind gate by deadline, no free-flight physics contact, both conservative sampled gaps above margins, measured integrated curvature <=120 deg, and continuous sampled TCP pose dwell within position and axis tolerance behind gate
timing_comparison: identical translational reference, shape endpoints and score deadline in both variable modes; schedules differ in both timing and rate; comparison identifies the package, not either factor separately
